posts.author: Th3L1ttle3Man
posts.body: Hello everyone, I just installed MZ after doing a bit of messing around with RPG maker 2003 and need help with a weird bug that I've found. When I open the Database, the popup that shows up is bigger than my laptop screen and the save changes button can't be pressed. I can't find an options menu that changes this, any idea of what I should do?

posts.author: caethyril
posts.body:
RPG Maker MZ requires a base screen resolution of at least 1280x768.
Check your system settings for display resolution and scaling.

posts.author: utunnels
posts.body: If you are using any version of windows, alt+space can bring up window menu. Then you press m and then arrow to move it. Or alt+space and then x to maximize it. It saves you when the window top is out of reach.
